mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, d.space_id, d.status AS document_status, s.archived AS space_archived, v.publication_protocol, v.publication_evidence, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_review r WHERE r.version_id = v.id AND r.state = 'IN_REVIEW') AS review_in_progress FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND d.status <> 'deleted'

SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, a.effective_from, COALESCE(a.until_kind, 'UNDECLARED') AS until_kind, a.effective_until, COALESCE(a.applicability_version, 0) AS applicability_version, COALESCE(a.corrected, FALSE) AS corrected, a.updated_at, COALESCE(d.current_version_id = v.id, FALSE) AS current FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id LEFT JOIN kb_document_version_applicability a ON a.version_id = v.id AND a.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document_version_applicability (version_id, doc_id, effective_from, until_kind, effective_until, applicability_version, corrected) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{documentId}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{untilKind}, #{effectiveUntil}, #{applicabilityVersion}, #{corrected}) ON CONFLICT (version_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document_version_applicability SET effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, until_kind = #{untilKind}, effective_until = #{effectiveUntil}, applicability_version = #{applicabilityVersion}, corrected = corrected OR #{corrected}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND doc_id = #{documentId} AND applicability_version = #{applicabilityVersion} - 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document_applicability_change (version_id, doc_id, before_effective_from, before_until_kind, before_effective_until, after_effective_from, after_until_kind, after_effective_until, visible_to_readers, reason) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{documentId}, #{beforeEffectiveFrom}, #{beforeUntilKind}, #{beforeEffectiveUntil}, #{afterEffectiveFrom}, #{afterUntilKind}, #{afterEffectiveUntil}, #{visibleToReaders}, #{reason})
